title: What Is a Scanned PDF? Scanned Copy vs Digital PDF
description: What a scanned PDF is, how it differs from a digital PDF and a scanned copy, how to tell them apart in 10 seconds, and when you need OCR or a scan look.
h1: What Is a Scanned PDF? How to Tell It Apart From a Digital PDF in 10 Seconds
keywords: how to tell if a pdf is scanned

cta_title: Need a PDF that looks like a scanned copy?
cta_body: Drop a digital PDF into the free tool, set skew, noise and paper tone, and download an image-based PDF that reads like a real scan. Everything runs in your browser.
